name: Listen Sync
author: David Baumwald (dream-encode)
description: Sends the show playback position to a Listen Sync relay and uploads the show audio files to it, so phones and browsers can play the audio in sync with the lights.

privacy.summary: Sends the current song name and playback position, and copies of the audio files in the Music folder, to the relay address you enter. Keeps nothing about anyone.

sends.what: current song file name, playback position and playlist song names
sends.why: so listeners can play the audio in sync with the show

sends.what: audio files from the FPP Music folder
sends.why: so listeners can download the audio before it plays

privacy.other: The relay token is kept in plugindata/fpp-plugin-listen-sync/ and removed on uninstall. Nothing is sent until a relay token is saved on the plugin page. Position data comes from FPP MultiSync, which must be enabled.
